conclusions.local_completion: For a finite-type scheme, a nonreduced Artinian FULL completed local ring at a closed point gives an entire open-and-closed fat component.
conclusions.cyclic_kernel: An existing fat component has monomial support and yields a fat component for Z^n/Zc, with fixed schemes interpreted as character-weight quotients, including nonreduced diagonalizable group schemes.
conclusions.torsion: Primitive c may be chosen when the original grading group is torsion-free; saturation cannot be assumed in general.
conclusions.positive_grading: Positivity makes c mixed-sign; the cited equivariant finite-support replacement applies in the positive case.
conclusions.integrability: If a fine tangent direction has c_i=-b_i<0 and E_i<2b_i for some i, monic one-step S-pair reductions give a nonconstant flat k[t]-family preserving the FULL Hilbert function.
conclusions.squarefree: Squarefree monomial support is excluded in every characteristic; Altmann–Sturmfels is credited in its mixed-sign scope, and purely negative degrees are handled by the direct proof.
conclusions.sst: Only in characteristic zero, for the specified SST nonnormal chart and actions diagonal on its five displayed minimal coordinates, every nonzero coordinate-retention choice leaves a curve; the empty choice is reduced.
